story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Existing date identification and selectable population remain available for inbound 834 processing
Future eligibility uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date regardless of Assessment Date
gaps: Expected Result contains "unit and integration processing evidence is present in TM and SQL" in step 26, which cites DoD content from "Unit and integration tests have passed."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Assessment Date while relevant fields remain unchanged
Future eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and relevant field changes uses Eligibility Date
Current eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and relevant field changes uses Maintenance Date

wrong Facets product and extra bad check

Scenario description field requires: "4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged."; add a dedicated test case for it
Scenario description field requires: "5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged."; add a dedicated test case for it
Scenario description field requires: "6) Pregnancy changes while Assessment Date is unchanged."; add a dedicated test case for it

Scenario description field lists conditions: "1) Assessment Number changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 2) Assessment Tier changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 3) Assessment Division changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 6) Pregnancy changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 7) Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, and Assessment Division change together while Assessment Date is unchanged. 8) All relevant fields change together while Assessment Date is unchanged." but table has only test case ids "TC_001", "TC_002", "TC_003", "TC_004", "TC_005"

scenarios.title: Maintenance Date is not used outside the explicitly allowed current-eligibility unchanged-Assessment-Date field-change path
Regression coverage confirms corrected transaction date logic does not impact capitation or finance reporting

TC_003 is the closest related case, but scenario description also requires "6) Finance reporting remains accurate after corrected transaction effective date selection." Add a dedicated test case for it.
